factors.name: Trend Rider: trade only with the structure, from a zone that still holds
factors.call: ms.bias == 1 and zn.dz_since == 0 and zn.dz_tests <= 3 and green and body > 0.3 * range and close > zn.dz_lo
factors.put: ms.bias == -1 and zn.sz_since == 0 and zn.sz_tests <= 3 and red and body < -0.3 * range and close < zn.sz_hi
